messages:
alex: heads up — p99 on the microbatch path jumped after last night's deploy (heuristic_v2). noticed in prod us-west-2.
infra-bot: alert | p99_latency_us-west-2 > 1200ms for model-redwood-4q. Incident created: INC-4312
rita: omg, saw that. initial look: KV hit rate dropped ~18% around the same window.
sam: sharing a short profile dump from the affected host: 
```
# top events by time
kernel_select: 42.5%
kv_lookup: 18.9%
token_gen: 24.0%
tool_call_hotpath: 9.6%
other: 5.0%
```
lee: interesting — kernel_select that high usually means we kept switching exec kernels mid-session. did we enable the new dynamic-kernel-fallback?
alex: yes, heuristic_v2 enabled dynamic-kernel-fallback and widened microbatch window to 64ms. the intent was higher throughput.
maria: long prompts are common in this tenant mix — several requests had 6k tokens in context. combined with tool-calling chains, we observed regen loops.
sam: i dug into a few traces. pattern: long prompt -> first few tokens gen slowly (cold KV warmup) -> a tool call triggers synchronous request to tools service -> tools returns extra tokens that cause re-entry to runtime with different kernel selection -> kernel recompile/relocate -> big latency tail.
rita: reproducer command I used: `wrk -t8 -c200 -d30s --script long_prompt_toolchain.lua` where payloads include toolcall markers.
lee: logs from one trace: 
```
[0.002s] kernel_select: avx2 -> cuda_fallback (recompile)
[0.120s] kv_miss -> full_kv_restore (3 shards)
[0.245s] tool_call: sync -> wait 180ms
[0.430s] regen: appended tokens -> kernel_select: cuda_fallback -> rebind
```
alex: so root causes look like: widened microbatch window causing more kernel churn on mixed workloads, lower KV hit-rate for long contexts, and synchronous tool calls creating blocking spikes.
maria: also saw a regression in the KV eviction heuristic — earlier worker builds prioritized prefix-only retention; heuristic_v2 changed to LRU across sessions, which doesn't favor long-prompts that need prefix cache.
sam: mitigation idea 1: revert microbatch window to 32ms for p99-sensitive tiers. mitigation 2: add per-request kernel affinity locking (prevent kernel swaps for same session until N tokens).
rita: mitigation 3: treat tool-call boundaries as async: return partial tokens and offload tool call to async worker, avoiding synchronous pause in the main token loop.
lee: quick experiment: patched runtime to pin kernel per-session and forced kv_prefetch on first chunk. in canary this reduced p99 by ~280ms on heavy prompts.
alex: nice. action items:
- (alex) roll microbatch window back for prod-slo tier and monitor p95/p99 for 24h.
- (rita) revert KV eviction change in next patch, add test for long-prefix retention.
- (sam) prototype kernel-affinity lock PR and bench with mixed toolcall workload.
- (lee) coordinate with tools team to prototype async tool call handshake.
- (maria) assemble customer traces (3 tenants) and attach to INC-4312.

maria: one more note — we should add a perf regression test that simulates long-prompt + synchronous toolcall loops; current CI only runs short-context sims.
alex: agreed. create a minimal script and add to nightly perf.
rita: i've added the revert to staging. will ping when deployed. :thumbsup:
sam: leaving one log snippet here for future debugging: 
```
trace_id=abc123 host=i-0f.. latency=1350ms path=microbatch kernel_seq=[avx2,cuda_fallback,avx2]
kv_hits=0.23 kv_restore_ms=110 tool_wait_ms=180 regen_tokens=42
```
lee: if we decide to keep heuristic_v2 for throughput, let's add an auto-slo switch: if p99 > threshold, automatically tighten microbatch/backoff and enable kernel pinning per session.
alex: agreed — rolling back for SLO now, but keep v2 in canary with the kernel-affinity change.
infra-bot: incident INC-4312 updated: mitigations applied (microbatch window rolled back), status=monitoring.
rita: closing note — let's track this in the perf board and schedule root-cause postmortem if p99 doesn't stabilize.
alex: thanks everyone, great triage.
